bitmap_caching_enabled.description: Enable caching of bitmaps to disk.

client_hostname.description: Client hostname to send to the server. Empty to use default system hostname.

color_depth.description: Color depth in bits per pixel (8, 15, 16, 24, or 32).

colormap_private_enabled.description: Use private colourmap for better color accuracy.

compression_enabled.description: Enable compression of the RDP datastream.

console_mode_enabled.description: Attach to the console of the server.

desktop_geometry.description: Desktop geometry in WxH[@DPI][+X[+Y]] format or 'workarea' or percentage.

disable_client_encryption_enabled.description: Disable encryption from client to server.

domain.description: Domain for authentication. Empty string to omit.

embed_window_id.description: Window ID to embed rdesktop into.

experience_level.description: Network experience level: m[odem], b[roadband], l[an].

force_bitmaps_enabled.description: Force server to send screen updates as bitmaps.

keyboard_map.description: Keyboard layout keymap (e.g., en-us, de, fr).

local_cursor_enabled.description: Use local X cursor inherited from window manager.

mouse_motion_disabled.description: Do not send mouse motion events.

numlock_sync_enabled.description: Enable numlock synchronization between Xserver and remote session.

redirections.description: List of device redirection strings to enable. Format: -r compliant strings like 'clipboard:PRIMARYCLIPBOARD' or 'disk:share=path'. Items are flat strings representing the -r argument value.

remote_control_disabled.description: Disable use of remote control features.

seamlessrdp_shell.description: Path to seamless rdp shell executable to enable SeamlessRDP.

server_address.description: The hostname or IP address and optional port of the RDP server.

single_app_button_size.description: Button size for single application mode in pixels or 'standard'.

startup_shell.description: Startup shell/application to start instead of Explorer. Empty to use default desktop.

tls_version.description: TLS version: 1.0, 1.1, or 1.2. Empty to allow all.

username.description: Username for authentication on the server.

window_title.description: Window title for the RDP client window.

wm_keybindings_preserved.description: Do not override window manager key bindings.

working_directory.description: Initial working directory for the user session.
